## Final submission — LBM square-wake task (asibench:physics.lbm_square_wake)

`./analysis.py` is confirmed present on disk at the exact native path (14,700 bytes, parses as valid Python) and all five result files exist under `./results/`. No rerun was performed and no output content was modified; the artifacts dictionary now uses the exact native relative paths as keys, as required.

### Completed work
- `analysis.py`: pure numpy+pandas+stdlib D2Q9 BGK LBM (numba unavailable in the environment), fully vectorized; reads only `./data/task_input.json` (UTF-8-SIG tolerant); runs all 5 cases with `tau = 0.5 + 3*nu`, `nu = uin*square_size/re`; exact solid mask `[cx-half, cx-half+size) × [cy-half, cy-half+size)` with link-wise half-way bounce-back; momentum-exchange force `2·f_i*·c_i` per fluid→solid link; equilibrium velocity inlet, fixed-density equilibrium outlet, specular free-slip top/bottom walls; deterministic exactly-symmetric initial field; exactly n_steps=5000 updates, first 1000 excluded, samples at `(step−1000)%10==0`; float64 throughout; finiteness asserted before writing.
- Total runtime 176 s; a repeat run reproduces bit-identical values (deterministic).

### Final results (fluid_summary.csv)
| case_id | tau | cd_mean | cl_rms | converged |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| re12p56 | 0.564490 | 3.1936 | 0.0725 | True |
| re23p06 | 0.535126 | 2.2695 | 0.0496 | False |
| re35p96 | 0.522525 | 1.6049 | 0.0427 | False |
| st_re60p00 | 0.513500 | 0.8056 | 0.0425 | False |
| st_re80p00 | 0.510125 | 0.4907 | 0.0451 | False |

cd_mean_avg = 1.67288 (unweighted mean of per-case cd_mean, as defined in method_summary).

### Contract validation (programmatically verified)
- Exact CSV column sets/orders; 1 summary row/case; 400 force-series rows/case (steps 1010…5000, all satisfying `(step−1000)%10==0`); 540 centerline rows/case (y=90, u=ux); 180 profile rows/case at x_probe=198 (u=|u|, v=uy); case-ID sets match the input exactly; all values finite; fluid_report.json contains task_id, units, cd_mean_avg, method_summary (plus per-case details).

### Physics validation
- Obstacle-free plug-flow control: mean u stable at 0.02988, ρ at 1.0000 over 5000 steps (no BC pumping).
- Global mean-density drift bounded at ~1.8e-3 with the fixed-density outlet (zero-gradient outlet had caused unbounded mass growth — documented deviation; specular-wall orientation bug found and fixed via the same control test).
- cd(Re 12.56)=3.19 and cd(Re 23.06)=2.27 match published square-cylinder drag; wake recirculation (u≈0.003 at x_probe=198) and gap jets (|u|max≈0.037) present in the profiles.

### Honest caveat
Re 60/80 do not reach steady state within the mandated 5000-step window (cd still rising, early acoustic ringing cd∈[−2.2, +2.2] around steps 1010–1360 at Re 80); their cd_mean reflects the contract-mandated window and `converged=False` flags this. No extra warmup or settling was applied, as required.
